minors.issue: j/k and the arrow keys are captured on the whole window, with preventDefault, whenever focus is not in an editable field, including when focus is in the sidebar or the top bar (carried from round 1).
minors.scenario: With focus on a sidebar link, ArrowDown no longer scrolls the page. It moves the list highlight and pulls focus into the list.

minors.issue: The row focus ring is drawn inset (outline-offset -4px), while docs/specs/ui.md §4 specifies a 2 px offset and handles clipping with 4 px padding on the scroll container.
minors.scenario: Pressing j moves focus to a row, and the accent ring draws inside the row edges instead of 2 px outside them, unlike every other focusable element.
